items.title: My chat overlay keeps desyncing audio
items.content: I can't keep my chat overlay in sync with OBS audio. It's hard to troubleshoot and it breaks stream immersion.

items.title: Need a quick clipper that marks moments live
items.content: Wish there was a hotkey that marks timestamps during stream so I can clip later. Current tools are annoying.

items.title: Scheduling collabs across time zones is a mess
items.content: We struggle to find a time that works. Need something that shows overlap and auto-suggests slots.

items.title: Captioning workflow is too expensive
items.content: Auto captions are costly for long streams. Looking for cheaper options that still look good.

items.title: My VOD chapter tool is broken after update
items.content: The chapter marker plugin doesn't work anymore. Bug makes it unusable.
